*** FTSE CAVEAT — SECOND DAY RUNNING ***
.FTSE again returned the previous session's close (10,497.94, stamped 2026-10-05) on all three reads at
07:54, 08:00 and 08:06 BST, i.e. after the London open. The same thing happened yesterday morning. The
published FTSE level is therefore Monday's close, not a Tuesday intraday price, and the drivers say so.
This now looks like a systematic lag in the CNBC .FTSE feed in the first half-hour of the session rather
than a one-off; worth working around with a second provider if it recurs.

GILT: Monday's close reads 5.423% in the prev field, which is consistent with the 5.41 published at 20:01
last night plus a late move, and with Trading Economics showing 5.39 this morning against our 5.3836.
Published -0.04 against Monday's close. Unlike yesterday the prev field is internally consistent today.
